observable_requests.affirmative_interpretation: The foreground has a centroid-centered, balanced organization that agrees strongly with itself after a half-turn.

panel_descriptions.neg_0: A narrow upright D-shaped loop with a straight left edge and a curved right edge.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: Two close diagonal beaded strands rise together, with a dark serrated cluster concentrated at their upper-right ends.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: Two angular triangular lobes meet near one vertex, with a curved outer edge on the upper-left lobe.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: A large broken circular arrangement combines a heavy curved arc, circles, squares, small triangles, and an upward arrow.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: A slim diagonal pointed outline has a long straight upper edge and a serrated lower edge.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: Two joined irregular loops form a bent figure-eight arrangement decorated unevenly with circles, squares, triangles, and zigzags.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: Two similar slanted quadrilateral loops touch at a central point and extend in opposite directions.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A long bent ribbon-like polygon has opposing tapered terminal sections arranged around its center.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: Two similar narrow triangular loops cross at a central point and extend in opposite directions.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: Two end lobes meet along one slanting central path, with the larger upper lobe balanced by the lower terminal structure.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: Two triangular loops meet at a central point and project toward the upper left and lower right.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: Two close upright curved strands carry circles at their upper ends and complementary square and zigzag decorations at their lower ends.

model_payload.positive_description: The positive figures have a centroid-centered organization whose overall ink distribution and second-moment shape are balanced under a 180-degree rotation.
